sar_narrative: The entity SYN_c2e9a586, an offshore holding company in Panama, executed eight wire transfers between 2026-03-25 and 2026-03-30 to VYCGA Industries LLC, QQM Services LLC, DBAZD Imports LLC, KJY Services LLC, PSXRV Solutions LLC, AJLY Associates LLC, OZJK Imports LLC and CFQZB Group LLC, each between $593,834.14 and $778,884.92 and labeled "peel-chain hop". The activity shows a vs_declared_volume_ratio of 7.88 and a tx_total_usd of $4,720,455.74, far exceeding the declared monthly volume of $597,008, indicating layering behavior consistent with 31 CFR 5318(g) and FinCEN guidance; refer the matter to the senior AML investigator.

2. Detect cycles (A→B→C→A) and peel chains (descending amounts hop-by-hop) in the counterparty graph.
3. Compute total volume into/out of cycle members; compare to declared volume.
